These Terms apply in accordance with the legislation of the Republic of Moldova, including, without limitation: the Civil Code of the Republic of Moldova (Law no. 1107/2002), Law no. 195/2024 on the protection of personal data, and Law no. 139/2010 on copyright and related rights.

sections.title: Purpose of the Site and description of the Services

clauses.text: The Site serves to present and promote the activity of Pixtoon, a studio specialising in the production of 2D and 3D animated content. The Site provides Users with information about services, a portfolio of work, articles and means of contact.

The services offered by Pixtoon include, without limitation: commercial animation and explainer videos, motion graphics, 3D animation and video, visual effects (VFX), character and brand mascot design, as well as other related creative services.

The Site is not an online store and does not allow the direct purchase of services or products. No information on the Site constitutes a binding offer within the meaning of the law; services are contracted under the conditions of art. 9.

clauses.text: Access to the Site is, in principle, free of charge. The costs of the internet connection and the equipment needed to access the Site are borne exclusively by the User.
The User undertakes to use the Site in good faith, for legitimate purposes and in accordance with the applicable legislation, this document and good morals.

clauses.text: Service requests submitted through the Site (contact form, e-mail or phone) constitute an invitation to make an offer and do not constitute a firm order or a contract. Nothing on the Site constitutes a binding offer on the part of Pixtoon.

The provision of services generally follows this process: (a) receipt of the Client’s request; (b) clarification of requirements; (c) submission of an Offer by Pixtoon; (d) conclusion, where applicable, of a separate service contract detailing the scope, price, deadlines and specific conditions.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing (for example, through a confidentiality agreement), Pixtoon has the right to include the works produced in its own portfolio and promotional materials.
In the event of any inconsistency between this document and the service contract concluded with a Client, the provisions of the specific contract prevail.

Details on the cookies used, their purpose and duration, as well as how to manage preferences, are set out in the Cookie Policy, available on the Site.

The Site is provided “as is” and “as available”. Pixtoon makes reasonable efforts to ensure the proper functioning of the Site, but does not guarantee uninterrupted, error-free or permanent access to it.

The information published on the Site is of a general and informative nature and does not constitute a contractual obligation, a warranty or professional advice.
